og.alt: Reactivity: Delete useMemo, useCallback and every dependency array. 2.1× faster effect propagation than Preact Signals (1,407 vs 2,874 ns, 100 effects)

hero.alt: Schematic signal graph: count.set(2) travels from the count signal to the computed double and on to the two places that read it, a Badge text node and a document.title effect. A separate theme signal and the class it feeds stay grey: they do not depend on count, so they never run.
